summary: Iteration 6 verified the 9 factual/clarity corrections requested for Units 1-5 (DDA rounding, CMY theory-vs-practice, HSV/HSI, Unit 2 composite+Cohen-Sutherland, Unit 3 back-face N.V<0 convention, Unit 4 PAL/NTSC + qualitative compression ratios, Unit 5 JPEG main-lossy-step + MPEG P/B/MP4-container). Extended /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py from 49 to 73 tests, adding 5 new correction classes with positive substring assertions AND explicit negative checks on json.dumps of each full unit document ('HSI' absent from unit 1, 'N.V >=' / 'half the faces' absent from unit 3, '2-4x'/'10-100x' absent from unit 4, 'only lossy step' absent from unit 5, 'MPEG-4 -> MP4' absent). 73/73 backend tests pass. critical_code_review_comments: No pre-existing assertions referenced the old wording, so nothing had to be relaxed; the 3 initial failures in my new tests were my own wrong field targets (Z-buffer 'closest wins' lives in working as 'CLOSER (smaller z)', 'eliminate many faces' lives in quick_facts, and 'Main information loss -> QUANTIZATION' lives in exam_tip not memory_trick). Assertions were corrected to the actual fields; content itself was already right.

Minor clarity nit (not requested, pre-existing): the Unit 4 RLE solved table's third column header 'Characters' shows 2/2/2/2 (encoded length per run), which reads ambiguously next to runs AAAA/BBB/CC/D; the total of 8 and ratio 1.25 are correct so no functional issue.
